model_annotation: This pie chart represents a survey response regarding the integration of design into a product development process. The “Много добре е интегриран” (Very well integrated) slice is orange and represents approximately 24%. The “Добре е интегриран” (Well integrated) slice is green and accounts for approximately 25%. The “Слабо е интегриран” (Weakly integrated) slice is red and covers approximately 8% of the total area. The “Не е интегриран такъв подход” (Not such an approach integrated) slice is purple and represents approximately 20%.  A legend is included, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered from smallest to largest in terms of their area.
